note: The outreach pushback on installers (the rustup debate, getplumber/plumber#390): the rustup project's own installer piped into sh, in a test job with contents: read and no secret. The installer can change without a change in this repository, but whoever controls it reaches a job that holds nothing: runner abuse and a poisoned cache at worst, Medium, never High. The debian:forky-slim container is a mutable image into the same job, Medium as well.
